about.headline: Practical automation. A clear first step.
about.intro: FlowAgent is an AI automation agency for businesses that want less repetitive work and more time to grow. We connect content, publishing and customer conversations to the tools you already use.
about.mission: We connect the tools involved in a repeated task: your store, customer messages, content queue, and internal tracking. The starting point is a specific job with a clear input and an outcome you can check.
about.whyAi: AI can help draft content and interpret customer questions. Rules, approved source material, and human review are still needed where an incorrect answer or action could affect your business.
methodology: Choose a specific workflow and define its scope.
Identify the source data, permissions, and tools it needs.
Test typical requests and exceptions before launch.
Agree on approval steps, handoff, and ongoing support.
credibility: Custom connections using n8n and APIs

faq.question: What is RAG and why is it better?
faq.answer: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) means the chatbot retrieves real information from your documents before generating an answer. This makes responses far more accurate and relevant than generic AI.

faq.question: What documents can I train the chatbot on?
faq.answer: PDFs, web pages, Google Docs, Notion pages, FAQ lists, support articles — any text-based knowledge source your business uses.

faq.question: Where can the chatbot be deployed?
faq.answer: We can embed it on your website, connect it to WhatsApp, or integrate it with Slack, Discord, or other platforms.

faqs.question: What does FlowAgent automate?
faqs.answer: FlowAgent builds n8n workflows for social publishing, blog content, WhatsApp support, lead follow-up, bookings, inbox management, reporting, and business operations. Each workflow connects your tools and is scoped around a specific task.

faqs.question: Do I need to provide Shopify access?
faqs.answer: Only for workflows involving Shopify. Other services use the relevant WhatsApp, spreadsheet, CRM or publishing permissions agreed during setup.

faqs.question: Can I approve content before publishing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every automation system can include a human approval step before publishing. You control whether content goes live automatically or after your review.

faqs.question: Are the SEO articles written specifically for my products?
faqs.answer: Articles are generated using your product catalogue, target keywords, and audience. Review is recommended to check facts, product details, and brand voice before publishing.

faqs.question: Which platforms support automated video publishing?
faqs.answer: We support Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook. Publishing setup depends on platform API access and your account permissions.

faqs.question: Are traffic, rankings, views, or sales guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. SEO, reach, engagement, and sales results depend on many factors including your market, competition, and products. We guarantee consistent content delivery, not specific performance outcomes.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my monthly subscription?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can cancel at any time. Cancellation stops future renewals. No refunds are provided for work already delivered during the current billing period.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom n8n workflows?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build custom automation workflows for any business process that can be connected via API. Contact us to discuss your specific needs.

faqs.question: What does $59/month include?
faqs.answer: The existing $59/month packages include setup and AI/WhatsApp usage for the agreed system. Services marked “Scoped quote” are priced separately after reviewing your tools, volume, and requirements.

faqs.question: Who owns the generated content?
faqs.answer: You own all content generated for your brand. Articles, videos, and other deliverables are yours to use, republish, or modify.

faqs.question: Is the plan unlimited?
faqs.answer: Every plan covers an agreed workflow, integrations and usage range. We confirm expected message volume, actions and support before launch.

faqs.question: When does a person take over?
faqs.answer: We agree on handoff rules before launch, including unanswered questions, sensitive requests and customers asking for your team. The workflow can flag these for human review.

faqs.question: What information does the assistant use?
faqs.answer: The products, policies and FAQs you approve. We agree access permissions and the information to record before setup. AI answers and exception handling are tested before launch.

blogPosts.title: AI automation for business growth: where to start first
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn how to identify the first automation opportunities that actually save time and improve speed in your business.
blogPosts.author: FlowAgent Team
blogPosts.metaDescription: A practical guide to starting AI automation in your business with the highest-value workflows first.
blogPosts.contentHtml:
Most businesses do not need more tools. They need fewer manual steps, clearer process ownership, and better execution speed. The best place to start with AI automation is where time is already being lost every week.

Start with repeatable work

Look for tasks that happen often, require multiple steps, and create bottlenecks. Lead follow-up, onboarding, support routing, and content distribution are common starting points.

Focus on operational leverage

Choose workflows that improve speed, consistency, and visibility. The goal is not just to automate for the sake of novelty, but to create a more scalable operating model.

Build around outcomes

The strongest automation systems improve response time, reduce human error, and give teams more room for strategic work.

blogPosts.title: Why RAG chatbots are better for customer support
blogPosts.excerpt: Generic bots guess. RAG chatbots retrieve. Here is why that difference matters for support quality and customer trust.
blogPosts.author: FlowAgent Team
blogPosts.metaDescription: Understand why retrieval-augmented chatbots can improve support quality and reduce incorrect AI answers.
blogPosts.contentHtml:
Retrieval-augmented generation gives AI access to the specific knowledge your business wants it to use. That matters in support because accuracy and relevance shape trust.

More grounded answers

Instead of relying only on general model knowledge, a RAG chatbot pulls from real documents, policies, and internal content.

Better customer experiences

Customers receive answers that are closer to what your team would actually say, improving confidence in the experience.

Lower support load

RAG chatbots can reduce repetitive support demand while still keeping your service more aligned with reality.

blogPosts.title: AI video marketing for modern brands
blogPosts.excerpt: AI video is not just about speed. It is about testing more ideas, shipping faster, and turning creativity into a repeatable system.
blogPosts.author: FlowAgent Team
blogPosts.metaDescription: Explore how AI video helps businesses produce more content, test faster, and create better marketing momentum.
blogPosts.contentHtml:
Video content has become one of the most important growth assets for modern businesses, but traditional production can be slow and expensive. AI-assisted video changes that operating equation.

Faster production cycles

Brands can move from idea to asset much more quickly, which makes experimentation easier.

More variants for testing

Instead of relying on one expensive concept, teams can launch multiple angles, hooks, and creative directions.

Better systemization

When video becomes a repeatable workflow, it supports better marketing consistency over time.
